messages.title: First public Garda release
body: Visible release history was reset to the Garda 1.0.0 baseline.
The public project line now uses the Garda name.

messages.title: Project memory refresh
body: Project memory mode was updated in 1.1.0.
Before starting task work, let your agent execute the project-memory refresh prompt so local project memory is current for the new workflow.
New or refreshed workflow configs now default full-suite validation placement to after_compile_before_reviews; existing explicit placement settings are preserved.

Garda self-guard is enabled by default for application workspaces: agents can no longer self-escalate into --orchestrator-work for protected Garda bundle edits. Operators can change the policy with garda workflow set --garda-self-guard on|off.

messages.title: Optional quality gate controls
body: Garda now includes an optional quality gate for project-specific self-check rules before expensive validation work.
After updating, run garda ui --actions and open the Quality Gate settings to review the default rules, adjust test-only exclusions, and add rules that match your project.
This gate is advisory and does not replace mandatory compile, full-suite, or independent review gates.

messages.title: Review reliability and faster navigation
body: Garda 1.3.0 strengthens reviewer provenance, findings coverage, recovery, and task-scope contracts while reducing repeated Git and runtime-history work in next-step.
The workspace-local SQLite catalog remains a disposable projection: canonical files still own lifecycle, review, security, cleanup, configuration, and completion decisions.
After updating, run garda doctor and review the release notes for the compiled-only package surface and the current Node 22.13+/24 compatibility contract.
